summary: Completed comprehensive testing of extended booking system supporting venue, audio_engineer, and recording_studio categories. All backend APIs (14/14 tests passed) and frontend features working correctly.

Backend: POST /api/bookings creates booking to venue category (status: pending)
Backend: GET /api/bookings/venue/{id}/calendar works for venue category
Backend: POST /api/bookings creates booking to audio_engineer category (status: pending)
Backend: GET /api/bookings/venue/{id}/calendar works for audio_engineer category

Backend: POST /api/bookings creates booking to recording_studio category (status: pending)
Backend: GET /api/bookings/venue/{id}/calendar works for recording_studio category

Backend: POST /api/bookings to musician (non-bookable) returns 400 Bad Request
Backend: GET /api/bookings/venue/{id}/calendar for musician returns 400 Bad Request
Backend: Audio engineer can accept booking (status: accepted)
Backend: Recording studio can decline booking (status: declined)
Backend: Audio engineer calendar shows accepted booking
Frontend: Login page works correctly
Frontend: Admin user menu shows 'My Bookings' link (non-bookable category)

Frontend: Audio engineer user menu shows 'Manage Bookings' link

Calendar endpoint properly validates provider category before returning events
seed_data_creation: Created test users for venue, audio_engineer, recording_studio, and musician categories during backend tests. Created TEST_venue_ui_231808 and TEST_audio_eng_231838 for frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Extended booking system fully tested. All three bookable categories (venue, audio_engineer, recording_studio) can receive booking requests. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_extended_bookings.py cover complete booking flow for all categories including validation that non-bookable categories (musician) are rejected. Frontend verified: Navbar shows correct booking links based on user category, ProfilePage shows calendar/booking buttons for bookable categories, VenueBookingsPage accessible to all bookable categories.
